name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.202: The data store is SQLite now, through the Entity Framework Core that Jellyfin already
    ships, and the plugin writes its own file (subdl-scribe.sqlite) — never Jellyfin's database, which
    offers plugins no interface and is rebuilt by its own migrations. A new version that meets an old
    data file IMPORTS it once: measured against a real file, 117 of 117 rows over ten areas, including
    the retry budgets and the burned-candidate verdicts, which are work rather than data — losing them
    re-fetches candidates that were already screened. The old file is kept. 35 KB smaller package
    (1,337,266 -> 1,301,728 B): not the full engine weight, because the import still needs it to read.
  Older entries (before v12.1.12.192) were removed on 08.10.2026 to keep this file
  and the shipped ZIP small. They remain in the git history: git log -- build.yaml .
